data.body: **[P2] Account for parents that ended in an earlier invocation.** `endedOperationIds` is invocation-local, so a retained callback completed between invocations is still attached to its already-ended context when replay skips that context. This makes topology depend on the invocation boundary and can place the completion outside its parent's lifetime. Consult the parent status and timestamps in operation history, falling back to `Workflow` when the terminal parent predates the completion, and add a cross-invocation direct-callback regression test.
